value.rationale: The invariant is the Haar mean number of vertices in a centered random prism section, a natural observable of emerging combinatorial-slicing research. The accepted result supplies a complete exact all-height and all-\\(n\\ge5\\) evaluation, a unique nontrivial golden-ratio optimum for the pentagon, and a sharp critical dimension/base-side threshold at which both optimization and asymptotic decay change. It is a coherent motivated geometric phase classification, not an arbitrary fixed numerical example or a claim about the elementary angle identity alone.
